newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Alpargatas begun as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Alpargatas begun as buy.

text.p: -- Santander Investment said in a report it has initiated coverage of Brazilian textile firm Alpargatas Santista Textil with a buy rating and a 12-month target price of $200 per lot of 1,000 preferred shares.

-- Santander analyst Daniela Muszkat Bretthauser cited low production costs and financial leverage, efficient product distrubution, high operating margins and a "belief that the company is undervalued relative to its international peers."

-- "Our 12-month target price of $200 per 1,000 PN shares represents 43 percent upside (potential), which compares with our 20 percent return for the Ibovespa," she wrote, referring to the Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index of 48 most-traded shares.
-- Alpargatas is among the four largest producers in the world, with a four-percent global market share, she added.
-- Santander said it expects earnings per share of $18.70, $23.50 and $27.30 for 1997, 1998 and 1999 respectively. The company reported earnings of $9.00 a share in 1996.
-- Alpargatas preferred was untraded at 1318 local/1218 EDT on the Sao Paulo bourse at its Wednesday's close of 150.00 reais.
